card.name: Day-of-month digits in dates
card.fires_on: A digit that gives the day of the month in a date, usually right after a weekday or month name, as in 'Friday, 5 March 2004' or 'Wednesday, December 7th'. It also fires on the first digit of a number in the other style of dates.

modes.label: Day after weekday
modes.description: The day number follows a weekday name in a news or blog date line.

modes.label: Day after month name
modes.description: The day number follows an abbreviated or full month name in an event or appointment date.

modes.label: Other number in parentheses
modes.description: A first digit of a temperature in a bracketed conversion also fires weakly.

card.plain: It fires on the day-number in a calendar date, such as the 5 in Friday 5 March.
